hypothesis_origin: User-attributed 17 October 2026 hypothesis; AI-proposed operationalization with narrow proponent agreement to the hidden-symbol bridge on 18 October 2026

design.purpose: Feasibility pilot with prespecified signal tests; not a definitive confirmatory experiment
design.arm_allocation: uniform 24-of-48 participant allocation concealed before enrollment
design.target_sampling: independent uniform with replacement for every unique participant-person-trial
design.einstein_role: public-knowledge calibration only, excluded from primary targets

bridge.statement: New random symbol associated with a person dossier is accessible despite not belonging to the person's lifetime knowledge

acceptance_record.context: Reply to the preceding draft summary identifying the random-association bridge as the open decision
acceptance_record.scope: Agreement to use person-associated hidden symbols as a pilot design assumption
acceptance_record.interpretation: Narrow contextual assent; not a separate empirical construct-validity finding or blanket protocol approval

primary: MT minus RT participant-level randomized instruction contrast

analysis.joint_signal_rule: both primary tests pass and integrity/feasibility gates pass
analysis.h1_test: exact upper-tail binomial under iid secret-target null
analysis.h2_test: participant-level 24-of-48 allocation randomization; sharp no-instruction-effect null
analysis.bootstrap_unit: participant within arm, preserve all within-participant pairings
analysis.missing_primary_rule: zero verified success, fixed randomized denominators if lawful; also report bounds
analysis.stopping_rule: 48 randomized or eight weeks, whichever first; no interim accuracy; no efficacy stopping

planning_h1.assumptions: ideal homogeneous independent-hit model only; not joint, heterogeneous, attrition or interaction power

blockers: proponent instruction-fidelity, necessary-condition and minimum-effect specification
independent statistical review and joint simulations
acquisition and custody implementation plus adversarial audit

artifacts.reference_code_scope: synthetic calculations only; does not implement recruitment, acquisition, target generation or cryptographic custody
